checks.text: Typing 50 in the field labelled Bill shows 50.00 in the field labelled Total.
Selecting 15% in the Tip Percent dropdown shows 7.50 in the field labelled Tip.
Entering 3 in the People field shows 18.75 in the field labelled Each Pays.
Entering 0 in the Bill field shows 0.00 in the Total field.
Entering 100 in the Bill, 10% in Tip Percent, and 2 in People shows 55.00 in Each Pays.
Entering 20 in the Bill, 0% in Tip Percent, and 4 in People shows 5.00 in Each Pays.
Entering 100 in the Bill, 20% in Tip Percent, and 5 in People shows 24.00 in Each Pays.
Entering 75 in the Bill, 10% in Tip Percent, and 3 in People shows 27.50 in Each Pays.
Reload keeps the values entered in Bill, Tip Percent, and People fields.
